text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's local idol activities are 
going smoothly, and her fame continues to 
skyrocket. She's successfully promoted the 
"Champions Cup" far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the content promoting Tomakomai 
isn't getting as many views as hoped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If things continue like this, even if her 
popularity peaks, Tomakomai's recognition 
will only see a slight bump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, if she could just win the 
Champions Cup and promote Tomakomai on 
that stage, she believed everything would 
turn around for the better.
